scope.summary: Execute the feature-by-feature professional qualification matrix over Rust-native workflows, structural interchange, optional Unreal automation, manual Blender evidence, failure/recovery, visual output and performance budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Every required capability row references exact MTs, commands, surfaces, manual anchors, reference sources, fixtures, artifacts, metric thresholds, DCC versions, and inspected reviewer evidence.

Qualification covers success, boundary, unsupported, cancellation, recovery, concurrency, accessibility, no-context backend/GUI operation, round-trip, visual comparison, performance, and claim-state transitions.
No cargo-only, changed-hash-only, MT-name-only, or uninspected artifact evidence can set QUALIFIED; the claim gate remains fail-closed until direct proof exists.

The matrix covers the full professional dependency chain, including native shell and surface registry, task-oriented UserManual, diagnostics and optional pillars, interlink/mix, project lifecycle, sewing/arrangement, simulation, fabric lab, BodyKit creator/contact, materials, groom, render, publish, DCC, and the MT-780 semantic gate under 13.35 [TAI-QA-001..007] and 13.36 [TAI-GATE-002..005].

For every required native surface family, Argus/AccessKit proves exact surface and dynamic entity ids, empty/loading/populated/preview/conflict/failure/recovery/success states, accessibility, responsive layout, backend receipt agreement, and renderer-console cleanliness; a reviewer directly opens each selected capture and compares it with the pinned Marvelous Designer or Daz Studio reference before QUALIFIED.

A no-context model completes the matched backend-only and GUI-only workflow using only the exact task-specific Tailor UserManual anchor, command ids, surface paths, structured state, diagnostics, and recovery instructions; command inputs/outputs, authority versions, receipts, artifacts, and visible success state must agree.

The active TailorInterchangeProfile or runtime capability row records exact direction, versions, hashes, supported payloads, losses, unsupported cases, privacy behavior, artifacts and qualification receipts before the action is exposed.

Proof includes successful canonical Rust behavior plus one missing/removed-adapter or unsupported-direction case and demonstrates no partial authority mutation, silent fallback, data loss or false qualification.

The product path is Rust-owned, local and offline: Python/PyTorch, generated executable scripts, cloud services, implicit network access and runtime downloads are prohibited; optional adapters are pinned and removable.
scope.risk_if_missed: Feature ownership without witnessed qualification cannot establish professional usability or full-parity claims.

surfaces: Tailor project and Cloth authoring surface family
Tailor BodyKit creator, face, genitals, rig, and content surface family
Tailor material, shader, groom, and render surface family
Tailor DCC, diagnostics, capabilities, and help surface family

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > DCC parity and qualification

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Feature ownership without witnessed qualification cannot establish professional usability or full-parity claims.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
